head: working-tree
subject: gRPC xDS HCM HTTP fault injection
change: HCM listener filter chains now decode and enforce envoy.extensions.filters.http.fault.v3.HTTPFault on the client path. The supported subset covers fixed grpc_status and http_status aborts, header_abort, fixed_delay and header_delay, FractionalPercent, max_active_faults, upstream_cluster scoping and HeaderMatcher gating. Route and virtual-host typed_per_filter_config overrides replace or disable the listener RBAC/fault policy, with route scope taking precedence; a direct HTTPFault or RBACPerRoute replaces the policy and a disabled FilterConfig removes it. Percentages are required for abort and delay, matching grpc-js-xds validation, and numerators above the denominator are capped. HTTP abort statuses use the response-trailer fallback mapping; HTTP 200 and gRPC OK never abort. Header aborts read x-envoy-fault-abort-grpc-request, x-envoy-fault-abort-request and x-envoy-fault-abort-request-percentage; header delays read x-envoy-fault-delay-request and x-envoy-fault-delay-request-percentage. Fixed delays above the 24-hour bound are rejected and header delays are clamped. Unary attempts, retries, hedging and streaming opens evaluate the policy; aborts return the configured status with message 'Fault injected' without a backend, and delays sleep only up to the attempt/open deadline. upstream_cluster restricts injection to the selected cluster and manager-prefixed cluster keys are normalized before comparison. Fault headers share RBAC's HeaderMatcher decoder and all must match. RBAC runs before fault injection, and fault-before-RBAC, downstream_nodes and response_rate_limit are rejected.

tests.unit: src/grpc/fault.zig covers fixed gRPC/HTTP aborts, OK/200 no-abort cases, header abort and percentage overrides, fixed/header delays, max_active_faults, upstream_cluster matching and non-matching clusters, HeaderMatcher gating, missing percentages, multiple abort kinds, unsupported top-level fields, oversized delays and deadline-bounded sleep.
tests.lds: src/grpc/xds/rds/tests.zig decodes route and virtual-host typed_per_filter_config entries. src/grpc/xds/lds/tests.zig accepts fault filters with header matchers, requires RBAC-before-fault ordering, and rejects duplicate fault filters, malformed percentages and unsupported fault fields. src/grpc/xds/lds/controller_tests.zig publishes a 100% UNAVAILABLE abort listener and requires both a unary response and a duplex terminal event with 'Fault injected' before any connection, then verifies a route RBAC ALLOW override and a disabled route fault override.

notes: The interop peer validates the fault fixture with grpc-js-xds's own HTTPFault parser and Listener validator. Aborts triggered by x-envoy-fault-abort-grpc-request and x-envoy-fault-abort-request never increment backend counters. A zero abort-percentage header re-allows the same request, and a 40 ms header delay is observed before the backend response. Streaming abort returns a terminal event from the pre-opened stream without a connection.
